exam.title: Backup and Recovery Practice
exam.subject: Systems
exam.instructions: Work through both questions. You can request a hint or explanation before submitting.

questions.text: What best verifies that a backup can recover an application?

options.text: Restore it to an isolated environment and test the application.
Check that the backup file exists.
Confirm that the scheduler has a job for the application.

questions.text: A tested restore procedure can reduce uncertainty during an outage.
